title: She survived the Titanic... and that's not the crazy part #titanic #shorts
description: Violet Jessop was aboard the Olympic when it collided with HMS Hawke in 1911, survived the Titanic in 1912, and survived the sinking of the Britannic in 1916. Sources: Wikipedia, National Geographic, History UK.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: This woman survived the Titanic. And that isn't even the craziest part.
scenes.title: MISS UNSINKABLE

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Violet Jessop worked on the Olympic, the biggest liner in the world, when it crashed into a warship in nineteen eleven.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: In nineteen twelve, she moved to its sister ship. The Titanic.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: When it hit an iceberg, she made it into a lifeboat and survived.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Then in World War One, she was a nurse on the third sister ship, the Britannic. In nineteen sixteen, it hit a mine and sank.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: She jumped out of her lifeboat as it was being pulled toward the ship's propellers, and survived again.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: Three sister ships, three disasters, and she lived through all of them. Would you ever get on a boat again?
